critical_cautions: Do not universalize singleton names, unconditional updates/recreation, always-Ping readiness, SDK language restrictions or OLM prerequisites.
Chapter8 wrongly treats conversionReviewVersions as CR API versions; it describes ConversionReview protocol versions. Sample reverse conversion is explicitly lossy.
Prometheus configuration can reload via sidecar; do not enforce restart for all settings.
Archived CoreOS etcd operator is historical, not a recommendation or hosting-control-plane recovery procedure. Missing Pods alone do not authorize restore/reinitialization.
